name: Video Description Generation Template
description: SEO-optimized video descriptions with engagement optimization
prompt:
# YouTube Video Description Generation

## Video Information
- **Title**: {{title}}
- **Video URL**: {{url}}
- **Duration**: {{duration}}
- **Content Type**: {{contentType}}
- **Target Audience**: {{targetAudience}}

## Content Summary
{{scriptSummary}}

## Keywords & SEO Data
{{keywords}}

## Description Requirements

Create an SEO-optimized video description that maximizes discoverability and engagement:

### 1. Structure & Length
- **Total length**: 200-500 words optimal
- **Above fold**: First 125 characters (mobile preview)
- **Hook section**: Compelling opening (first 2-3 lines)
- **Content preview**: What viewers will learn
- **SEO optimization**: Strategic keyword placement
- **Engagement drivers**: Comments, likes, sharing prompts

### 2. Opening Hook (First 125 Characters)
- **Value proposition**: Clear benefit statement
- **Curiosity trigger**: Compelling reason to watch
- **Keyword integration**: Primary keyword naturally included
- **Urgency/relevance**: Why this matters now
- **Emotional hook**: Connect with viewer needs

### 3. Content Preview Section
- **Timestamp highlights**: Key moments in video
- **Learning outcomes**: What viewer will gain
- **Value bullets**: Specific takeaways
- **Problem/solution**: Address viewer pain points
- **Social proof**: Why this content matters

### 4. SEO Optimization
- **Primary keyword**: 2-3 mentions naturally integrated
- **LSI keywords**: Related terms throughout
- **Long-tail phrases**: Specific search terms
- **Topic clusters**: Related concept coverage
- **Search intent**: Match user search behavior

### 5. Engagement Elements
- **Comment prompts**: Questions to drive discussion
- **Community building**: Encourage interaction
- **Sharing triggers**: Reasons to share content
- **Subscribe motivation**: Value of following channel
- **Series connection**: Link to related content

## Output Format

Provide the description in this exact JSON structure:

```json
{
  "videoId": "{{videoId}}",
  "title": "{{title}}",
  "description": {
    "fullText": "Complete description text",
    "sections": {
      "hook": "First 125 characters optimized for mobile preview",
      "contentPreview": "What viewers will learn and key highlights",
      "valueProposition": "Why this video matters and what makes it unique",
      "engagement": "Questions and prompts to drive comments and interaction",
      "tags": ["#hashtag1", "#hashtag2", "#hashtag3"]
    },
    "seoMetrics": {
      "primaryKeyword": "Main target keyword",
      "keywordDensity": "2-3%",
      "lsiKeywords": ["related", "terms", "used"],
      "searchIntent": "informational/tutorial/review",
      "readabilityScore": "8th grade level"
    },
    "characterCount": "Total character count",
    "estimatedReadTime": "30-45 seconds"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": "[timestamp]",
    "optimizationFocus": "Primary optimization strategy",
    "targetAudience": "Specific viewer demographics",
    "engagementPotential": "High/Medium/Low with reasoning",
    "seoStrength": "Score 1-10 with analysis",
    "competitorAnalysis": "How this stands out from similar content"
  }
}
```

## Quality Standards
- Authentic and helpful tone
- Accurate content representation
- Professional grammar and spelling
- Strategic keyword placement
- Engagement-optimized structure
- Mobile-first formatting
- No external CTAs or promotion
- Value-focused messaging
instructions: Use the primary keyword in the first 25 words
Create scannable content with short paragraphs
Use 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end
Focus on viewer value, not channel promotion
